rho_reference.protocol: StrongRho (rho.signed_frobenius_strong: signed Frobenius and negation, 32 lanes, dp 4) on the same target, in the same process, after each IC solve (PROTOCOL.md, 'Rungs and runs')
rho_reference.unit: group additions per one-target solve (counted); wall seconds in the same process reported beside
rho_reference.binary_or_process: examples/ic_m2_linear.rs, one process per rung, binary sha256 in raw/binary.sha256; both arms use semaev_decomp::Gf2
rho_reference.strongest_available_basis: Koblitz curves over prime-degree fields: Aut is negation and the Frobenius eigenvalue lambda, both folded by StrongRho (automorphisms = 2n)
rho_reference.gae_band_statistic: rung a=0 n=41 (4 targets), mean per solve. IC = counted group additions + w x counted elimination word XORs (its uncounted field multiplications omitted, which only raises it). Rho = counted group additions + w x 3 x walk steps (an upper bound on its canonicalizations, partition hashes and table accesses; its receipt counters were not recorded per row). Every smaller rung orders the same way (REPORT.md, section 5a).
rho_reference.order_basis: rho below the IC at w = 0, 0.1 and 1 on every rung
